features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.desc: You learn 2 languages and gain Expertise in two skills from your domain's list.

features.name: Read Thoughts
features.desc: By expending a use of Channel Divinity, you read a creature's thoughts and can implant a command in its mind (Wisdom saving throw).

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.desc: As an action, for 10 minutes you can see and hear a familiar location up to 1 mile away.
